tracks.title: When God Shakes Hands With The Devil

verdict.detail: The album's main issue on Discogs isn't vinyl; this is from the first year it was pressed on vinyl.

cutters: Lacquer Cut at Optimal Media GmbH

notes.text:
Gatefold 2LP edition on 180g vinyl with 8 page lyric book and art print on the LP (side D).
Some copies have an additional 4 page lyric book.

Rhythm section for tracks 1, 2, 4, 7, 8 (A1, A2, A4, B3, B4) recorded at Mosh Studios, Sao Paulo, Brazil.
Gliss guitar on "Shakti Yoni and the Dingo Virgin" recorded at Moat Studios, London.
Additional production at Bananamoon Observatory Studios, New Brighton, NSW, Australia.
The samples on tracks 5, 8, 10 (B1, B4, C2) are courtesy of Charly Acquisitions Ltd and are taken from the albums 'Angel's Egg' & 'You' released by Charly Records.
Mastered at Ginger Studio, Tel Aviv.
℗ 2014 Gong
